title: OR-Path Meta Experiment Card — Schema
description: Generalized single-factor experiment card for any OR-Path domain. Generalizes contracts/tube_experiment_card.schema.json: one factor changes per card, the baseline artifact and frozen factors are declared before the run, acceptance criteria are fixed before the run, and every run carries a hard wall-clock timeout. Legacy Tube cards (experiment_id + budget) are mapped onto the canonical id + timeout_sec shape by the test adapter.

schema.description: Stable card id of the form orpath.<domain>_experiment_card.v<N>.

id.description: Unique experiment card identifier (legacy Tube cards use experiment_id).

domain.description: OR-Path domain this experiment belongs to (e.g. tube, microgrid, polyomino).

owner_agent.description: Agent responsible for this experiment; must be an authorized protocol role.

baseline_artifact.description: Path to the frozen baseline artifact this experiment is measured against.

frozen_factors.description: Factors held constant so the change is attributable to changed_factor alone.

acceptance.description: Acceptance contract fixed before the run (hard gates, primary/secondary criteria, stop rule).

output_path.description: Where the experiment result artifact is written.

timeout_sec.description: Hard wall-clock timeout in seconds. A timeout is not evidence of infeasibility.

name.description: Single factor name that changes in this experiment.

candidate.description: Candidate value of the factor; must differ from baseline.

changed_factor.description: Exactly one factor changes per experiment card; baseline and candidate must differ.
